sobre: Living Dex trophies, one list per game. Loaded on every boot by `pnpm seed:dex` (see src/lib/dominio/dex-trofeus.ts). A checkpoint lists the national numbers it unlocks in that game (libera) and where that came from (fonte); a marco unlocks nothing; a calculado (only for jogo "home") is never marked: it holds while the records meet its regra (see src/lib/dominio/dex-trofeus-home.ts). Order in the file is the display order. Platinum is derived, never listed.

pt-BR.descricao: Escolha seu primeiro parceiro no laboratório do Professor Oak, em Pallet Town.

en.descricao: Pick your first partner at Professor Oak's lab in Pallet Town.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Brock em Pewter City e ganhe a Boulder Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Brock in Pewter City for the Boulder Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Atravesse o Mt. Moon e escolha entre o Dome Fossil e o Helix Fossil. O outro, só por troca.

en.descricao: Cross Mt. Moon and choose the Dome Fossil or the Helix Fossil. The other one only comes by trade.

pt-BR.descricao: Compre o Magikarp do vendedor no Pokémon Center da Route 4, perto do Mt. Moon.

en.descricao: Buy the Magikarp from the salesman at the Route 4 Pokémon Center, by Mt. Moon.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Misty em Cerulean City e ganhe a Cascade Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Misty in Cerulean City for the Cascade Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Ajude o capitão do S.S. Anne a melhorar do enjoo e ganhe o HM01 Cut.

en.descricao: Help the S.S. Anne's seasick captain and receive HM01 Cut.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Lt. Surge em Vermilion City e ganhe a Thunder Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Lt. Surge in Vermilion City for the Thunder Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Ouça o presidente do Pokémon Fan Club em Vermilion e troque o Bike Voucher por uma bicicleta em Cerulean.

en.descricao: Listen to the Pokémon Fan Club chairman in Vermilion and trade the Bike Voucher for a bike in Cerulean.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Erika em Celadon City e ganhe a Rainbow Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Erika in Celadon City for the Rainbow Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Desmonte o esconderijo da Equipe Rocket embaixo do Game Corner de Celadon e saia com o Silph Scope.

en.descricao: Take down the Team Rocket hideout under the Celadon Game Corner and leave with the Silph Scope.

pt-BR.descricao: Liberte o espírito da Marowak na Pokémon Tower e salve o Mr. Fuji. Ele dá a Poké Flute.

en.descricao: Free the Marowak's spirit in the Pokémon Tower and rescue Mr. Fuji. He gives you the Poké Flute.

pt-BR.descricao: Toque a Poké Flute e enfrente os dois Snorlax que bloqueiam as Routes 12 e 16.

en.descricao: Play the Poké Flute and face both Snorlax blocking Routes 12 and 16.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Koga em Fuchsia City e ganhe a Soul Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Koga in Fuchsia City for the Soul Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Ache os Gold Teeth no Safari Zone e devolva ao guarda. Ele dá o HM04 Strength.

en.descricao: Find the Gold Teeth in the Safari Zone and return them to the Warden for HM04 Strength.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença o Karate Master do Fighting Dojo, em Saffron, e escolha Hitmonlee ou Hitmonchan. O outro, só por troca.

en.descricao: Beat the Karate Master at the Saffron Fighting Dojo and choose Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan. The other one only comes by trade.

pt-BR.descricao: Expulse a Equipe Rocket da Silph Co. e vença Giovanni. Um funcionário agradece com um Lapras.

en.descricao: Drive Team Rocket out of Silph Co. and beat Giovanni. An employee thanks you with a Lapras.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Sabrina em Saffron City e ganhe a Marsh Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Sabrina in Saffron City for the Marsh Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Responda o quiz do ginásio, vença Blaine em Cinnabar Island e ganhe a Volcano Badge.

en.descricao: Answer the gym quiz, beat Blaine on Cinnabar Island and earn the Volcano Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Depois de Blaine, aceite o convite de Bill e ganhe o Tri-Pass: One, Two e Three Island.

en.descricao: After Blaine, take Bill up on his invitation and get the Tri-Pass to One, Two and Three Island.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Sevii Islands, Tri-Pass. PokeAPI encounters (FireRed): Ponyta and Rapidash only on Kindle Road and Mt. Ember, Moltres on Mt. Ember, Slugma and Magcargo in Mt. Ember, Dunsparce at Three Isle Port.

pt-BR.descricao: Encontre Lostelle no Berry Forest, em Three Island, e leve a menina de volta para casa.

en.descricao: Find Lostelle in the Berry Forest on Three Island and bring her home.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture Articuno nas Seafoam Islands, Zapdos na Power Plant e Moltres no Mt. Ember.

en.descricao: Catch Articuno in the Seafoam Islands, Zapdos at the Power Plant and Moltres on Mt. Ember.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Giovanni no ginásio de Viridian City e ganhe a Earth Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Giovanni at the Viridian City Gym for the Earth Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença a Elite dos Quatro e o campeão e entre no Hall da Fama. Na versão de Switch, o AuroraTicket e o MysticTicket chegam sozinhos.

en.descricao: Beat the Elite Four and the Champion and enter the Hall of Fame. On Switch, the AuroraTicket and MysticTicket arrive on their own.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen Versions (Differences in the Nintendo Switch release: tickets after the Hall of Fame), Cerulean Cave (Mewtwo and Wobbuffet open after the Hall of Fame).

pt-BR.descricao: Com 60 espécies de Kanto capturadas, já tendo ido a One Island e entrado no Hall da Fama, fale com o Professor Oak em Pallet.

en.descricao: With 60 Kanto species caught, having visited One Island and entered the Hall of Fame, talk to Professor Oak in Pallet.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: National Pokédex (FireRed and LeafGreen): before it, no Generation II or III species can be obtained and cross-generation evolutions fail. The list is every species above 151 in the FireRed catalog.

pt-BR.descricao: Busque o Ruby no fundo do Ruby Path, no Mt. Ember, e leve ao Celio. Ele dá o Rainbow Pass: Four a Seven Island.

en.descricao: Fetch the Ruby from the depths of the Ruby Path on Mt. Ember and bring it to Celio. He gives you the Rainbow Pass to Four through Seven Island.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Rainbow Pass (given by Celio after obtaining the Ruby; needed for Navel Rock and Birth Island). PokeAPI encounters (FireRed): species found only on Four to Seven Island, closed by evolution and breeding; Togepi is the Water Labyrinth egg.

pt-BR.descricao: Ajude Lorelei a expulsar a Equipe Rocket da Icefall Cave, em Four Island.

en.descricao: Help Lorelei drive Team Rocket out of Icefall Cave on Four Island.

pt-BR.descricao: Recupere a Sapphire da Equipe Rocket no Rocket Warehouse, em Five Island, e entregue ao Celio. O cão lendário do seu inicial começa a correr por Kanto.

en.descricao: Take the Sapphire back from Team Rocket at the Rocket Warehouse on Five Island and deliver it to Celio. Your starter's legendary beast starts roaming Kanto.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Roaming Pokémon (FireRed and LeafGreen): one beast per save, chosen by the starter (Squirtle: Raikou, Bulbasaur: Entei, Charmander: Suicune), roaming after the Sapphire is delivered. The other two only come by trade.

pt-BR.descricao: Resolva o quebra-cabeça de pedras do Tanoby Key, no Sevault Canyon. Os Unown acordam nas Tanoby Chambers.

en.descricao: Solve the boulder puzzle of the Tanoby Key in Sevault Canyon. The Unown wake up in the Tanoby Chambers.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Tanoby Key, Tanoby Ruins (the chambers only have Unown after the puzzle).

pt-BR.descricao: Em Cape Brink, Two Island, ensine Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant ou Hydro Cannon ao seu inicial totalmente evoluído e com amizade no máximo.

en.descricao: At Cape Brink on Two Island, teach Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant or Hydro Cannon to your fully evolved starter at maximum friendship.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture o cão lendário que corre por Kanto: Raikou, Entei ou Suicune, conforme o seu inicial.

en.descricao: Catch the legendary beast roaming Kanto: Raikou, Entei or Suicune, depending on your starter.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture Mewtwo no fundo da Cerulean Cave.

en.descricao: Catch Mewtwo deep in Cerulean Cave.

pt-BR.descricao: Use o MysticTicket e capture Lugia e Ho-Oh na Navel Rock.

en.descricao: Use the MysticTicket and catch Lugia and Ho-Oh at Navel Rock.

pt-BR.descricao: Use o AuroraTicket, resolva o triângulo da Birth Island e capture Deoxys.

en.descricao: Use the AuroraTicket, solve the Birth Island triangle and catch Deoxys.

pt-BR.titulo: De novo, só que mais difícil
pt-BR.descricao: Vença a Elite dos Quatro e o campeão com os times reforçados do pós-jogo.

en.descricao: Beat the Elite Four and the Champion with their stronger post-game teams.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao topo da Trainer Tower, em Seven Island, nas quatro modalidades: Single, Double, Knockout e Mixed.

en.descricao: Reach the top of the Trainer Tower on Seven Island in all four modes: Single, Double, Knockout and Mixed.

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a Pokédex de Kanto (os 150, sem Mew) e receba o diploma do Game Designer em Celadon. Exige troca com o LeafGreen.

en.descricao: Complete the Kanto Pokédex (all 150, Mew excluded) and get the diploma from the Game Designer in Celadon. Requires trading with LeafGreen.

pt-BR.descricao: Fuja dos Starly no Lake Verity com um Pokémon da maleta do Professor Rowan.

en.descricao: Fend off the Starly at Lake Verity with a Pokémon from Professor Rowan's briefcase.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Roark em Oreburgh City e ganhe a Coal Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Roark in Oreburgh City for the Coal Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Expulse a Equipe Galáctica do Valley Windworks, perto de Floaroma.

en.descricao: Drive Team Galactic out of the Valley Windworks near Floaroma.

pt-BR.descricao: Visite o Underground Man em Eterna City e ganhe o Explorer Kit. Os Pokémon Hideaways do Grand Underground se abrem, com Pokémon de fora de Sinnoh desde o primeiro dia.

en.descricao: Visit the Underground Man in Eterna City for the Explorer Kit. The Grand Underground's Pokémon Hideaways open, with Pokémon from outside Sinnoh from day one.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Grand Underground and the 18 hideaway pages (Base Encounters and Rare Spawns, which need no milestone); Serebii: PokéEarth, Grand Underground (Beginning and Rare Spawn encounters; 'Rare Spawns can appear at any time'). Both checked species by species on 2026-10-12, Brilliant Diamond only; an evolution counts with its pre-evolution. The later milestones (Strength, Defog, Icicle Badge, Waterfall) add only Sinnoh Pokédex species, which no checkpoint locks, so they are not checkpoints; the National Pokédex pool stays under brilliant-diamond-pokedex-nacional.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Gardenia em Eterna City e ganhe a Forest Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Gardenia in Eterna City for the Forest Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Expulse a Equipe Galáctica do prédio de Eterna e ganhe a bicicleta na loja de Eterna City.

en.descricao: Clear Team Galactic out of their Eterna building and get the bike from the Eterna City cycle shop.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Maylene em Veilstone City e ganhe a Cobble Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Maylene in Veilstone City for the Cobble Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Crasher Wake em Pastoria City e ganhe a Fen Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Crasher Wake in Pastoria City for the Fen Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture um Pokémon no Great Marsh de Pastoria.

en.descricao: Catch a Pokémon in the Pastoria Great Marsh.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Fantina em Hearthome City e ganhe a Relic Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Fantina in Hearthome City for the Relic Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Byron, pai do Roark, em Canalave City e ganhe a Mine Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Byron, Roark's father, in Canalave City for the Mine Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Candice em Snowpoint City e ganhe a Icicle Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Candice in Snowpoint City for the Icicle Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Invada o QG da Equipe Galáctica em Veilstone e liberte os três guardiões dos lagos.

en.descricao: Storm Team Galactic's headquarters in Veilstone and free the three lake guardians.

pt-BR.descricao: Pare Cyrus na Spear Pillar e capture Dialga.

en.descricao: Stop Cyrus at the Spear Pillar and catch Dialga.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Volkner em Sunyshore City e ganhe a Beacon Badge.

en.descricao: Beat Volkner in Sunyshore City for the Beacon Badge.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture Uxie, Mesprit e Azelf. A Mesprit foge e corre pelas rotas de Sinnoh.

en.descricao: Catch Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. Mesprit flees and roams the routes of Sinnoh.

pt-BR.descricao: Veja todas as espécies da Pokédex de Sinnoh (Manaphy não conta) e fale com o Professor Rowan em Sandgem. O Professor Oak vem atualizar a Pokédex.

en.descricao: See every species in the Sinnoh Pokédex (Manaphy excluded) and talk to Professor Rowan in Sandgem. Professor Oak comes to upgrade your Pokédex.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: National Pokédex (Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl), Grand Underground (pool grows with the National Pokédex), Old Chateau (Rotom after it), Fullmoon Island and Snowpoint Temple (need it). The list is every species in the BD catalog outside PokeAPI's original Sinnoh Pokédex, except Mew and Jirachi (save data bonus), Darkrai (event), Heatran and Giratina (Hall of Fame only), and the 37 the Grand Underground has from the start (see brilliant-diamond-kit-explorador).

pt-BR.descricao: Vença a Elite dos Quatro e Cynthia e entre no Hall da Fama. A Battle Zone se abre.

en.descricao: Beat the Elite Four and Cynthia and enter the Hall of Fame. The Battle Zone opens.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Stark Mountain (Heatran, in the Battle Zone), Turnback Cave (Giratina after the Hall of Fame), Fullmoon Island (Cresselia: Hall of Fame and National Pokédex), Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl (Arceus: Hall of Fame, National Pokédex and Legends: Arceus save data).

pt-BR.descricao: Com a Pokédex Nacional e o Hall da Fama, entre no Ramanas Park e use a Discovery Slate.

en.descricao: With the National Pokédex and the Hall of Fame, enter Ramanas Park and use the Discovery Slate.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Ramanas Park (opens with the National Pokédex and the Hall of Fame; the Discovery Slate calls Regirock, Regice and Registeel).

pt-BR.descricao: Capture Regirock, Regice e Registeel no Ramanas Park. A loja passa a vender a Johto Slate e a Soul Slate.

en.descricao: Catch Regirock, Regice and Registeel in Ramanas Park. The shop starts selling the Johto Slate and the Soul Slate.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Ramanas Park (Johto Slate in BD and Soul Slate after the legendary giants: Raikou, Entei, Suicune, Latias, Latios), Snowpoint Temple (Regigigas needs the three Regi in the party).

pt-BR.descricao: Capture Raikou, Entei e Suicune no Ramanas Park. Abrem-se as slates de Ho-Oh, Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza e Mewtwo.

en.descricao: Catch Raikou, Entei and Suicune in Ramanas Park. The slates for Ho-Oh, Kyogre, Groudon, Rayquaza and Mewtwo open up.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Ramanas Park (Rainbow, Oceanic, Tectonic, Stratospheric and Genome Slates after the legendary beasts in BD).

pt-BR.descricao: Leve Regirock, Regice e Registeel à Snowpoint Temple e capture Regigigas.

en.descricao: Bring Regirock, Regice and Registeel to Snowpoint Temple and catch Regigigas.

pt-BR.descricao: Acompanhe Buck pela Stark Mountain e capture Heatran.

en.descricao: Go through Stark Mountain with Buck and catch Heatran.

pt-BR.descricao: Atravesse a Turnback Cave e capture Giratina.

en.descricao: Make your way through Turnback Cave and catch Giratina.

pt-BR.descricao: Busque a Lunar Feather na Fullmoon Island e capture Cresselia, que foge e corre pelas rotas de Sinnoh.

en.descricao: Fetch the Lunar Feather on Fullmoon Island and catch Cresselia, which flees and roams Sinnoh.

pt-BR.descricao: À noite, capture o Rotom que vive na TV do Old Chateau.

en.descricao: At night, catch the Rotom living in the Old Chateau's TV.

pt-BR.descricao: Monte a sua base secreta no Grand Underground.

en.descricao: Set up your Secret Base in the Grand Underground.

pt-BR.descricao: Escave um fóssil nas paredes do Grand Underground e reviva o Pokémon no museu de Oreburgh.

en.descricao: Dig a fossil out of the Grand Underground walls and revive it at the Oreburgh museum.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença um Super Contest no nível Master, em Hearthome.

en.descricao: Win a Master Rank Super Contest in Hearthome.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença a Elite dos Quatro e Cynthia de novo, com os times da revanche.

en.descricao: Beat the Elite Four and Cynthia again, with their rematch teams.

pt-BR.descricao: Vença Palmer, o Tower Tycoon, na Battle Tower.

en.descricao: Beat Palmer, the Tower Tycoon, at the Battle Tower.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture todas as espécies da Pokédex de Sinnoh. Exige troca com o Shining Pearl.

en.descricao: Catch every species in the Sinnoh Pokédex. Requires trading with Shining Pearl.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao nível 5 e entre numa equipe. Ginásios e reides liberados.

en.descricao: Reach level 5 and join a team. Gyms and raids open up.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Trainer level (level 5 unlocks gyms and raids). The list is every non-Mythical Legendary released in GO, which come mainly from raids.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao nível 8 e comece a pesquisa especial da Equipe GO Rocket.

en.descricao: Reach level 8 and start Team GO Rocket's Special Research.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao nível 10 e faça a primeira troca com um amigo. É o caminho dos exclusivos regionais.

en.descricao: Reach level 10 and make your first trade with a friend. That is how regional exclusives arrive.

pt-BR.descricao: Mande um Pokémon do GO ao HOME e ganhe a Mystery Box. Aberta, ela atrai Meltan por uma hora.

en.descricao: Send a Pokémon from GO to HOME and get the Mystery Box. Opened, it draws Meltan for an hour.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Mystery Box (unlocked by transferring to HOME through GO Transporter; Melmetal evolves from Meltan with candy).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial A Mythical Discovery e capture Mew.

en.descricao: Complete the A Mythical Discovery Special Research and catch Mew.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (A Mythical Discovery, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial A Ripple in Time e capture Celebi.

en.descricao: Complete the A Ripple in Time Special Research and catch Celebi.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (A Ripple in Time, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial A Thousand-Year Slumber e capture Jirachi.

en.descricao: Complete the A Thousand-Year Slumber Special Research and catch Jirachi.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (A Thousand-Year Slumber, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial Investigate a Mysterious Energy e capture Victini.

en.descricao: Complete the Investigate a Mysterious Energy Special Research and catch Victini.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (Investigate a Mysterious Energy, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial Hooves of a Hero e capture Keldeo.

en.descricao: Complete the Hooves of a Hero Special Research and catch Keldeo.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (Hooves of a Hero, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial Finding Your Voice e capture Meloetta.

en.descricao: Complete the Finding Your Voice Special Research and catch Meloetta.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (Finding Your Voice, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial Grass and Gratitude e capture Shaymin.

en.descricao: Complete the Grass and Gratitude Special Research and catch Shaymin.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (Grass and Gratitude, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial Glitz and Glam e capture Diancie.

en.descricao: Complete the Glitz and Glam Special Research and catch Diancie.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (Glitz and Glam, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa especial A Striking Shadow e capture Marshadow.

en.descricao: Complete the A Striking Shadow Special Research and catch Marshadow.

trofeus.fonte: Bulbapedia: Special Research (A Striking Shadow, global and free, no end date).

pt-BR.descricao: Complete a pesquisa From A to Zygarde, juntando Zygarde Cells pelas rotas. O Zygarde não sai do GO.

en.descricao: Complete From A to Zygarde, collecting Zygarde Cells along Routes. Zygarde never leaves GO.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture um lendário numa reide.

en.descricao: Catch a Legendary in a raid.

pt-BR.descricao: Capture seu primeiro shiny.

en.descricao: Catch your first shiny.

pt-BR.descricao: Faça uma troca da sorte (Lucky Trade).

en.descricao: Get a Lucky Trade.

pt-BR.descricao: Purifique um Pokémon sombrio.

en.descricao: Purify a Shadow Pokémon.

pt-BR.descricao: Encontre Giovanni com o Super Rocket Radar e vença.

en.descricao: Track down Giovanni with the Super Rocket Radar and win.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue a Best Buddy com um parceiro.

en.descricao: Reach Best Buddy with a buddy Pokémon.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao posto Ace na GO Battle League.

en.descricao: Reach the Ace rank in the GO Battle League.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao posto Legend na GO Battle League.

en.descricao: Reach the Legend rank in the GO Battle League.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao nível 20.

en.descricao: Reach level 20.

pt-BR.descricao: Chegue ao nível 30.

en.descricao: Reach level 30.

en.descricao: Reach level 40, the game's old level cap.

en.descricao: Reach level 50, clearing the level-up challenges on the way.

en.descricao: Reach level 80, the current level cap.
